Priya (CS): Quick heads-up — customer NovaLabs spiked usage overnight, QBR forecast +38%. Need a fast mitigation plan before Friday.
Liam (FinOps): On it. Which flows? embeddings or chat?
Tess (Onboarding): Mostly embeddings from a bulk ingest + nightly re-embed job. They also flipped to the high-dim model by mistake.
Marco (Solutions): That explains it. Fast triage: 1) pause re-embed job, 2) flip to embed-512-quant, 3) enable chunk caching. Order matters for speed.
Priya (CS): I'll message the customer that we're pausing the job and scheduling a 30m ops call. Need numbers for the QBR slide: delta, mitigation impact, and an ask.
Liam (FinOps): Delta if unchecked ~ $11.2k/mo. Estimated reduction with model flip + cache ~67%. With throttling too, net ~75%.
Tess (Onboarding): Paused the nightly job at 07:08 PT and requeued low-concurrency batches.
AlertBot: :warning: NovaLabs project NV-7 at 81% monthly credits.
Marco (Solutions): Runbook snippet for engineers (paste to ops):
```
PATCH /v1/projects/NV-7/config
{ "embedding_model": "embed-512-quant" }
# set soft quota via console to 60% of current rate
```
Priya (CS): For asks: propose either a 2-week Dedicated trial to show predictable throughput or a one-time 20% credits buffer tied to adoption milestones. Which do we prefer?
Liam (FinOps): Dedicated trial preferred — proves ROI and addresses renewal risk. Offer credits buffer only if trial isn't feasible.
Priya (CS): Action items: Liam finalize slide (ETA 2h), Marco add short appendix with per-route metrics, Tess keep imports paused until sign-off, Priya draft customer note and book ops call.
Marco (Solutions): Added appendix items and will upload to the shared deck link.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. Will update once customer call is done. :thumbsup:
